description: Three-Phase Power Flow Dataset for the Brazilian ATU10 Distribution Feeder (Araçatuba - São Paulo) is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Cristhian Oliveira (University of Sao Paulo). Repository Description This document describes the columns and data structure of each file used to model the real Brazilian distribution feeder ATU10 from the city of Araçatuba, São Paulo. The dataset contains the input data required to reproduce the feeder model allowing static power flow simulations. Coverage: national (BR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
